query: Invert every reason Striker will fail so the replacement can be built cleanly from the ground up with IBKR as the data + execution venue.
grok_message: Striker is not a foundation — it's a narrow, brittle, single-venue threshold detector. Moving to IBKR while keeping the same pattern creates reconciliation nightmare. Invert: build from IBKR data up, not bolt IBKR onto Striker. Six failure modes identified: single-venue coupling, noise/alpha ratio, stateful supervision tax, hybrid venue mismatch, ops death spiral, psychological local maximum.
kairos_message: Routed to Grok as scout — completed full inversion analysis.
openclaw_message:
Six inverted design principles for project-hephaestus:
1. Multi-Venue Mesh: IBKR as primary data bus for equities/options/futures, crypto as secondary lane via Bybit — normalized to one canonical tick schema.
2. Signal Stacking: multi-timeframe confirmation + volume profile before any alert. IBKR gives real volume Striker never had.
3. Stateless Event Bus: no single process owns truth. Structured ticks publish to shared bus, any agent subscribes.
4. Normalized Tick Schema: IBKR ticks and crypto ticks map to same format — one backtesting engine, one signal, one execution template.
5. Self-Healing Pipeline: IBKR gateway as own systemd unit (not inside an agent). Auto-restart on disconnect. WolfWatch consumes event bus, not PID checks.
6. Clean Slate: Striker stays running in parallel until Hephaestus proves >50% fewer false signals in shadow mode.

Hard rule: IBKR gateway is infrastructure, not an agent. Agents come and go; the gateway persists.
